title: M2.6: External-origin authority: data not instruction, no approvals over channels, reply in kind
description:
Encode contract section 6. External-origin turns get the grant of their trust class; the message origin and sender are placed in the model input as data about the source; no external text can approve, create a rule or change a ceiling; an approval.required during an external-origin turn sends only a deep-link notice (no token); reply in kind is not a consequential send under the stated conditions, everything else is a send gated by exact operation approval; unattended external-origin turns stop visibly or run only against an exact human-created rule.

Acceptance criteria:
- A message that says the user already approved changes nothing
- An approval-class action proposed from an email turn creates an approval card and waits; the email receives only a link
- Reply to the same participants with no attachments needs no approval; adding a Cc or a new recipient needs approval
- Guest grant forbids computer and consequential classes

Gherkin: features/external_origin_authority.feature

Depends on: M2.1, M1.4

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
